description: A fist of rock crusted in grey-green lichen. Cragback is made of these, and misses each one when it goes.
lore: The lichen is a clock. It wants forty still years to come in that thick, and a face that has just lost a stone is bare — so the pale patches on a [[monsters/granite_bear|Cragback]] are a robbery ledger, readable from the next ridge and dated by how far the green has crept back over them.

Which is how the trade found out the thing it does not repeat at fires. A well-robbed one is slower. Take enough off a hillside and the hillside labours, so the crews go back to the animals they have already opened, because those are the easy ones, and they keep going back, and the bare faces spread. A crusted fist of rock fetches eight. A day's walk out and a day's walk back, for eight.
